# Agreement — CASES

The fixture project's description of work, kept in its ledger. A clause is declared by a list
item that starts with its ID in bold.

## Clauses

- **AGR-1** — Every call to the service carries a key, and a call without one is refused.
- **AGR-2** — The service keeps what it has accepted.
- **AGR-3** — The client is configured with its key once, and sends it on every call.
